documents.text: In the supplied schema, T means TransactionExport, P means ProcessExport, and M means MessageExport. These aliases are used only to abbreviate the CSV file names in the lookup descriptions.

This profile compares P.TRANSACTION_ID to the identical T.TRANSACTION_ID string. It compares the pair (M.TRANSACTION_ID, M.PROCESS_ID) to the identical pair in P. Comparisons are literal string-value lookups in the supplied CSV snapshots.
These lookups do not assume a target has exactly one row, do not equate RETRY_COUNT across files, and do not establish a required child, a foreign-key contract, or an operational business obligation.

For this analysis, entity_family_complete=true means all rows in these three source CSV exports with each selected TRANSACTION_ID were loaded. It says nothing about completeness of operational logs outside these exports.

question: Propose useful reusable factual, non-statistical observations about linkage and data quality in this current CSV snapshot. Keep the scope to the stated string lookups, preserve unknown evidence, and do not assert a business contract, required child, or incident.
